message: Scaled 1 of 3 feed rates to 150 %; 1 left by the value filter, 1 left because the value filter cannot be compared with it. No machine: profile defaults assumed.

findings.message: F25 is not scaled: what it is worth depends on the machine (25 (As written: X50 and X50. are both 50 mm; G74/G75 P and Q, G76 Q and G83/G87 Q are in microns (Q6000 is 6 mm)), 0.25 (Increments of 0.001 mm (IS-B): X50 is 0.050 mm, X50. is 50 mm, C90000 is 90°; a point-less feed per minute in 1 mm/min (F200 is 200), per revolution in 0.01 mm/rev (F25 is 0.25 mm/rev)) or 0.25 (Increments of 0.0001 mm (IS-C): X50 is 0.0050 mm, X50. is 50 mm; a point-less feed per minute in 1 mm/min (F200 is 200), per revolution in 0.01 mm/rev (F25 is 0.25 mm/rev))), and none is chosen, so the "only feeds above" value (0.1) cannot be compared with it. It is left as it is.
F0.05 is at or below the "only feeds above" value (0.1), so it is left as it is.
